reviews.why: The energy sword's alcove floor (z 24.0) under the 26.0 surface over it: the level data has only that upper surface there, so the nav ended 2.35 u from the sword at (-123.2, 26.15, 24.13) and bots stood at the path's end for most of a match (logs/bug_reports/reach_20_sword_slayer_20261119-203930: 345 s within 4.5 u, never within 1 u). The cells are the owner's own LiDAR walk there (variants/v04abd98b/lidar.json, kind 1: a person); player spawns stand on it too (-123.29, 27.22), (-124.49, 26.16), (-125.52, 26.59). The last six cells are the way in at y 28.0-28.25, where the level data has no floor either: players stood there in that match (world rows: (-123.25, 28.25, 24.0) 167 times, (-123.0, 28.0) 10), and without them the alcove's floor was an island no path entered. The owner: "the lidar doesnt allow the bots to get to the sword"
